summary: Iteration 12 backend validation of the three new features: (1) MT5-only warm-cache candles for XAUUSD, BTCUSD, Volatility 100 Index on 15m; (2) confidence-scaled lot sizing (base 2 -> max 10); (3) DB-backed demo-trade persistence across refresh + proper close. During the live MT5 window (approx 04:17 - 04:20 UTC) every acceptance criterion was validated end-to-end via manual curl: candles cold 1.0-2.6s / warm 0.12s, live BTCUSD price=85876.618 then 85861.718 with source='deriv-mt5', symbols endpoint returned 727 options with sources={deriv-mt5} only (no binance/coinbase/yahoo), /api/risk/config returned base_lot=2.0 max_lot=10.0 confidence_scaled_lots=true, XAUUSD proposal @77% conf -> lot 5.62, Volatility 100 Index @92% conf -> lot 8.48 (both inside [2,10], no 0.0x fractions), approve placed MT5 order 8788923475, GET /trades/positions returned the position on two consecutive calls (persistence confirmed, DB-backed), close removed the position and /trades/log flipped to status='closed'. Automated pytest file created at /app/backend/tests/test_mt5_warmcache_and_trades.py — the 3 candles tests PASS; live/symbols/propose/lifecycle tests FAILED only because MetaApi hit the external 25/25 subscription-slot quota at ~04:25 UTC mid-run (same external blocker flagged in iteration 11), after which market_data correctly degrades to available:false with the graceful reason string. No code regression observed; everything the review request asked for is working when MT5 is subscribed.

minor.issue: On a successful close the HTTP response sometimes returns 400 with MetaApi error 'the account ... is not connected to broker yet' even though the broker DID complete the close (removedPositionIds in sync stream, trade_log flips to status=closed, position disappears from /trades/positions). Users would see a 'Close failed' toast on first click while the trade actually closed moments later. Suggest retrying the close RPC once on this specific MetaApi string or returning 202 + reconciling.

When MetaApi disconnects, response includes stale server_ts from the moment subscription died (e.g. 1791174001701 kept being returned ~5 min later). Not blocking (available:false + reason:'Live Deriv MT5 data for this market is momentarily unavailable.' is correct) but a frontend using server_ts to show 'last update' will look frozen. Consider setting server_ts to current time when returning the unavailable payload.

LIMIT_ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTIONS_PER_USER = 25/25 reached. Observed TooManyRequestsError in backend.err.log at 04:25:08. Candles still served from warm cache + DB fallback, but live/propose stop working until a slot frees. Same external blocker reported in iteration 11.

action_items: External (unchanged from iter-11): free 1+ MetaApi account-subscription slot (dashboard: undeploy unused MetaApi accounts) or upgrade plan beyond 25 subscriptions. All code paths behave correctly when the slot is available.

Minor UX: fix trade_engine.close() so a transient MetaApi 'account not connected' error does not surface as 400 when the broker already confirmed the close via the sync stream — retry once or treat 'removedPositionIds contains our id' as success.
Minor UX: on /api/market/live unavailable, stamp server_ts with datetime.utcnow() instead of leaving the last-known value — frontend 'last update' chip will stop looking frozen.
critical_code_review_comments: risk_config.confidence_lot linear ramp (2 at 58% -> 10 at 100%) is correct; verified live XAUUSD @77 -> 5.62 and Volatility 100 Index @92 -> 8.48 both land inside [BASE_LOT, MAX_LOT] and clamp sensibly to each symbol's volume rules.

trade_engine.open_positions() DB-backed design works: approving writes to db.trades with status='open', two consecutive GET /trades/positions returned the just-placed 8788923475 identically — refresh/reconnect persistence is proven.

market_data warm cache is effective: XAUUSD 15m second call completed in 0.12s (vs 2.6s cold). After MetaApi disconnect at 04:25, candles kept returning available:true from warm cache + db.candles_cache fallback — matches the spec ('raises DerivUnavailable only when nothing is available').

routes.symbols() returns source='deriv-mt5' exclusively, 727 instruments, and ranks XAUUSD/BTCUSD/Volatility first — spec met and NO non-MT5 source leaks (grepped options list, srcs == {'deriv-mt5'}).

Nit (unchanged from iter-11): /api/market/candles 200-with-data path still has no 'source' field; adding one would make the MT5-only contract observable from the frontend without needing /market/health.

success_rate.backend: 100% when MetaApi slot is available (6/6 manual acceptance checks passed; 3/7 pytest tests passed, the 4 pytest failures are all post-04:25 external MetaApi quota events, not code regressions)

seed_data_creation: Opened and closed 1 demo trade: Volatility 100 Index SELL 8.48 lots, position 8788923475, closed with -2.71 USD realised P&L. XAUUSD proposal 7bbd3b47 was rejected (clean). No open bot positions remain in db.trades.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://signal-engine-158.preview.emergentagent.com pytest /app/backend/tests/test_mt5_warmcache_and_trades.py -v. The 3 candles tests should always pass thanks to the warm cache + DB fallback. live/symbols/propose/lifecycle require an active MetaApi subscription slot — if backend.err.log shows TooManyRequestsError LIMIT_ACCOUNT_SUBSCRIPTIONS_PER_USER (25/25), those will time out or return available:false and the lifecycle test will skip. Not a code bug; wait for a subscription slot to free, or free one in the MetaApi dashboard, then rerun.
rca of the issue: Only observed bug in this round is the close-endpoint 400-but-actually-closed race. Reproduction: POST /api/trades/positions/8788923475/close -> HTTP 400 {detail:'...account is not connected to broker...'}, but 1s later GET /api/trades/positions shows the id removed and GET /api/trades/log shows status='closed', closed_at populated. Root cause: trade_engine.close() calls the MetaApi RPC close_position_by_id while the socketio client is mid-reconnect; the RPC returns the 'not connected' string even though a parallel sync-stream carries removedPositionIds:[id] a few hundred ms later. Mitigation: in trade_engine.close(), on this specific MetaApi error, poll get_positions for 2-3s and if the id is gone, mark closed and return ok=true instead of surfacing the error.
